text: **A table the parser cannot read FAILS LOUDLY and is never skipped.** `data-model.md` is hand-authored markdown with prose between its tables, so an unparseable table is the likely case rather than the exotic one -- and a skipped entity reported as checked is the defect this WP exists to remove, one level up. The refusal names the entity and the table it could not read.
